scope: Local ten-track iterative generation from Boards of Canada, best_available policy, seed 42, no LLM, CLAP or provider/network work. Same-binary uncached exact versus request-scoped exact cache; three samples of three measured iterations each. Catalog and engine initialization and full-playlist equivalence checks excluded from timings.

profiling.note: Separate CPU-profiled development run; profiling/startup affects timing, so headline results use the unprofiled paired benchmark.

equivalence: The real-catalog benchmark compares entire cached and uncached playlists, including scores/evidence/outcomes, before timing. Deterministic fixtures separately cover exclusions, ties, query changes, exhaustion, bounded fallback, cancellation and concurrent independent sessions.
limitations: One host and one real-catalog reference intent; not a held-out music-quality evaluation or universal speed guarantee.
No complete desktop/LLM/provider/CLAP end-to-end rerun; network and inference latency remain.
Moving unused selector helpers into test files preserves the historical oracle; Go's linker already discarded unused functions, so no binary-size saving is claimed.
